name: @tefx/cito
description: Notification-only cross-harness, cross-machine, multi-user wake and signaling service for coding agents

scripts.compile: rm -rf dist && tsc && if [ "$(uname -s)-$(uname -m)" = "Darwin-arm64" ]; then swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos13.0 src/macos/cito-ui.swift -o bin/cito-ui-darwin-arm64 && strip -x bin/cito-ui-darwin-arm64 && codesign -s - --force bin/cito-ui-darwin-arm64 && cargo build --release --manifest-path crates/cito-native/Cargo.toml && cp crates/cito-native/target/release/cito-native bin/cito-native-darwin-arm64 && strip -x bin/cito-native-darwin-arm64 && codesign -s - --force bin/cito-native-darwin-arm64 && rm -rf crates/cito-native/target; fi
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run compile
